summary: A hairline that separates groups of content, horizontally or vertically, with an optional short label.
whenToUse: Between groups that belong to the same surface but differ in kind: settings sections, toolbar groups.
Labelled, to name what follows ("Older changes") or to offer an alternative ("Or").
whenNotToUse: Between every list item: use spacing, or row borders in a Table.
To separate sections that have headings: the heading and space already do it.

dos.title: Vertical dividers between toolbar groups
dos.text: They group related controls without adding boxes.

donts.title: Stacked dividers and borders
donts.text: A divider next to a card edge doubles the line. Pick one.

accessibility: Base UI Separator: role separator with aria-orientation, announced as a boundary.
The labelled variant renders two separators around plain text, so the label is read once in order.
The line uses border.default (decorative); never rely on it to convey meaning.
contentGuidelines: Labels are one to three words in sentence case.
